sonnet.problem: This card tells the Chaldean army breaking down Jerusalem's walls. That comes right after the temple and the whole city are burned, and it is part of the city's destruction and exile. The card still ends with a drawer joke.
sonnet.rule: Heavy moments. A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts").
